page.layout: One page of text, with one note block in the left margin (Stapleton reference). Running head at top; heading QVÆST. I. with its title and SECT. I. above the text. Page number top left. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.l: QVÆST. I. An ulla Merita de Congruo antecedant Justificationem.
Fuerunt in Ecclesia Romana non nullius nominis Authores, qui hoc affirmârunt; adversus quam
opinionem Ecclesia nostra Anglicana Articulum suum, veluti salutiferum An-

l.i: Ante Gratiam Christi, & Sancti Spiritus inspi-
rationem, Opera nostra non sunt Dei grata, utpote quae
non dimanent à fide in Christo Iesu, nec
homines idoneos faciunt ad Gratiam recipiendam,
Gratiam de Congruo. Imò quia non secundum
Dei mandatum fiunt, non dubitamus quin in se

main_text.l: habeant naturam peccati. At verò quàm nullius
Scholastici Authores, ex illius Refutatione di-
scat Lector[?], non quidem nostrâ (nec enim ne-
cesse est) sed ex ipsorum Pontificiorum confessione,
qui in ea refellenda diligentem operam navârunt.
Summa est, Quòd omnes absq;[?] fide in Chri-
sto sub maledictione sunt, Gal.3. Quidni igitur Adver-
mur, & nobiscum, quoad licèat, in gratiam
ritum de Congruo, respectu primæ Gratiæ (inquit)
jam olim explosum est. Et paulò pòst, Vtcunq;

page.notes: Dark ink spot in the left margin, not text. Some letters in the Scholastici and Lector words and in absq; are blurred, so marked [?]. The mark after "redire" is a stray printed or scan mark and was not transcribed. The running head is taken as ANTIDOTUM; the "Cap. I." at the top right is a chapter number and was left out.
